title: Ever Given Suez Canal Blockage
description: Ultra-large container vessel Ever Given ran aground, halting ~12% of global trade and queuing 400+ vessels for 6 days.

title: Panama Historic Drought Restrictions
description: Gatun Lake water crisis forces ACP to slash booking slots from 36 down to 18-24 daily transits and draft to 44ft.

title: Red Sea Missile Attacks & Galaxy Leader Hijack
description: Houthi anti-ship missile campaign shuts Bab el-Mandeb / Suez corridor to western commercial container & tanker fleets.
source: US Central Command / IMO Maritime Safety Committee

title: Naval Escort Operations (Prosperity Guardian & Aspides)
description: Coalition naval escorts deployed in Red Sea and Gulf of Aden to protect international merchant shipping.

title: Sinking of MV Tutor in Red Sea
description: Uncrewed surface vessel strike sinks bulk carrier Tutor, cementing structural long-term Cape rerouting.

title: Panama Draft Restored to 48 Feet
description: ACP lifts draft restrictions back to full 48 feet (14.63m) baseline as seasonal rainfall refills Gatun Lake.
